summary: Banc of America Merrill Lynch Commercial Mortgage Inc., as depositor for BANK 2019-BNK24, filed an Item 8.01 8-K reporting that Situs Holdings, LLC was removed as special servicer of the ILPT Industrial Portfolio Mortgage Loan and Argentic Services Company LP was appointed successor special servicer effective September 21, 2026. The loan represented roughly 2.0% of the issuing entity's asset pool at cut-off and is part of a loan combination serviced under the MSC 2019-L3 PSA. The filing is routine CMBS transaction management, not a special situation.
